notes.detailedSummary: Retain algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero fields of arbitrary cardinality and smooth integral projective original X of dimension n≥1. The entire genuinely defined σ_D-dominated cone for fixed actual ample A and effective rational Cartier D is σ_D+PSH(A), with a unique actual quotient. Original generated local products, polar removal, energy, intrinsic targets, continuous derivatives, attainment, comparison and uniqueness are reconstructed. A direct finite-maximum proof avoids general nonample flattening. The effective full-divisor zero-mass cone is also reconstructed. These results do not establish minimal-reference volume mass or the unrestricted pseudoeffective theory.
notes.text:
The standalone reconstruction uses only the exact supplied actual-ample G0 grant and the explicitly supplied primary facts. Retained hypotheses are: k algebraically closed, trivially valued, characteristic zero, arbitrary cardinality; X smooth integral projective, dimension n≥1; actual rational bundles and actual metrics on the original X^an. Intersections retain their raw fundamental-cycle masses. Genuine numerical PSH(θ) means an all-point decreasing limit of ONE real FS net on actual B_i with c1(B_i)→θ. It is not an abstract completion.

For one defining FS net, upward rational coefficient rounding with uniform error δ, followed by adding δ, gives φ_i≤f_iδ≤φ_i+δ and g_iδ=f_iδ+δ. Given two pairs, choose i_3 above both and 2δ_3≤min(δ_1,δ_2). Then g_3≤φ_i3+2δ_3≤min(φ_i1+δ_1,φ_i2+δ_2)≤min(g_1,g_2). These non-strict inequalities remain valid at common poles. They produce a directed decreasing rational net with the same endpoint and numerical limit. Choose actual ample H with H−θ ample. Eventually H−B_i is actual ample; multiplication by its generating sections preserves the scalar FS function because their canonical logarithmic maximum is identically zero at every valuation-ring center. Thus the original function belongs to one genuine actual ample H cone, where G0 supplies finite divisorial values, the generic maximum, divisorial determination and usc obstacle comparison.

A new direct finite-maximum closure works in any fixed rational numerical class. For defining nets φ_i in B_i and ψ_j in C_j with common limit c1(L), put E_δ=L+δH. On suitable tails E_δ−B_i and E_δ−C_j are actual ample. Multiply the families into E_δ, clear degrees and take their union. The scalar is exactly max(φ_i,ψ_j). Admissible triples are directed by choosing smaller δ first and sufficiently late i,j. Their scalar limit is max(φ,ψ), and their classes tend to c1(L). This proves finite-maximum closure without nested extended-valued flattening.

Homogeneous projection is inf_{t>0}φ(tv)/t. For rational FS data it is a finite maximum of weighted section logarithms, with weights the vertices of {w≥0, Σw=1, Σwλ≥0}. Convex piecewise affine minimization in r=1/t proves the formula by examining zero, finite breakpoints, and zero-slope limits at infinity. Rational vertices become actual section monomials after clearing denominators. Clipping −∞ coordinates and commuting infima proves the formula at poles. Applying it within one rational defining net gives a genuine homogeneous decreasing net. For C=φ(v_0), the all-point decomposition is φ=sup_{λ<C}(hat(φ−λ)+λ). Finite rays use supporting lines. If a ray is −∞ at t_0, for s<t_0 choose a STILL SMALLER a<s and interpolate s between a and t_0 at finite stages. The finite uniform generic upper bound forces the value at s to −∞. This implements the requested correction to the earlier pole argument.

Every big actual rational L admits actual L=A+D on the same X: approximate θ_L−εH in the closed effective cone by an effective rational Cartier D so θ_L−D is ample, then set actual A=L−O(D). Numerical ampleness makes A actually ample. Fix this datum before a measure. For σ=log||s_D||, the whole genuine dominated cone is P_D={u genuine L-psh:u≤σ+C everywhere}. Multiplication by s_D proves σ+PSH(A)⊂P_D. Conversely, homogeneous h≤σ has rational FS approximants eventually below −t on the compact set {σ=−1}. Scaling and ample obstacle comparison give h_i≤tσ everywhere. Normal section division produces actual quotient FS functions in B_i−tD, without claiming they decrease. Embedding their rescalings in normalized actual A, with t→1 and scaling factor→1, lets G0 compactness produce an actual quotient with divisorial values h−σ. Divisorial determination gives h=σ+r everywhere. The homogeneous decomposition, finite maxima, compactness and usc obstacle principle prove the same result for every u in P_D. Thus F_D(ψ)=σ+ψ is an order bijection with uniquely retained quotient Q_D, including its values on the reference divisor.

Normalized compactness and genuine relative envelopes follow from this bijection. Empty feasible cones have envelope −∞; continuous finite quotient obstacles have minorants. This implements the second requested clarification.

The original operator is constructed before targets. In actual frames s_D=f e_D, the metric weight is h_L=h_A+log|f|, with the PLUS sign. Off D the metrized bundles are actually isometric. Independent bounded generated local FS/contact nets are compared in one actual ample collar: v=h_0+p, h=Rv+M+1, Ψ=max(w−h,0) on the compact collar and zero outside, Φ=p+Ψ/R. Compactness gives an eventual reference-winning outer strip. G0’s already-glued actual-ample contact bridge applies; independent nets with endpoint w have the same explicit global Φ. On the inner open w=RΦ+Rh_0+M+1. The Rh_0 term cannot be dropped. Compact tests and G0 mixed decreasing limits prove local-net, collar and harmonic frame independence. Shared lower floors establish reference compatibility and strict-winning locality in the stated generated category. No arbitrary local-current density theorem is assumed.

Polar removal uses an actual ample section potential a with poles on D. Integration by parts gives Cap_A{a≤−t}≤n/t. The energy estimate retains its factor t^n: J(c)≤1+∫_1^∞t^n Cap_A{c≤−t}dt. For χ(x)=1−(1−x)^α, 0<α<1/(n+1), χ(a) is an actual ample finite-energy pole on D. G0 mixed integrability makes the divisor and quotient poles null for finite-energy products and admissible targets. Increasing restricted reference-floor products define finite Radon measures; for finite-energy quotients their limit is derived to equal MA_A(ψ), of raw mass A^n. Mixed masses are (A_1⋯A_n). Arbitrary decreasing-net and integrable quotient-weighted limits follow with the test-containing pairing MINUS the zero-test pairing. Absolute integrability of σ is not required.

Actual mixed energy is E_D(u)=E_A(Q_Du), with E1_D=σ+E1(A) and translation slope A^n. Intrinsic targets have mass A^n and finite sup(E_D(u)−∫Q_Du dμ), equivalently integrability of every actual E1 quotient. All original continuous outer directions retain both derivative signs. G0 coercivity, normalized compactness by subnets, bounded-J target-integral continuity and energy upper semicontinuity yield an actual attained original maximizer. Both Euler inequalities identify its previously constructed operator with μ. Comparison, positive-mass domination and all-point uniqueness modulo constants follow through the unique quotient.

For L=O(D) with full effective reference, the divided homogeneous quotient classes tend to zero. Embed r_i/ε in one normalized actual ample cone with ε→0. Finite divisorial evaluation bounds give εM_v≤r_i(v)≤0, forcing h=σ everywhere. Homogeneous decomposition proves the ENTIRE cone {σ+C}. Raw local weights log|f|+C are harmonic off D; the genuine reference-floor operator and energy are zero. The normalized cone is a singleton, all continuous derivatives vanish, only target μ=0 is admissible, and actual solutions are unique modulo constants within that cone. The additional zero-volume application requires vol(O(D))=0. No probability normalization or zero-mass domination claim occurs.

The false general extended-valued flattening mechanism is retained diagnostically: families with isolated −∞ poles cannot switch families along a decreasing net, even though their separate decreasing limits coincide and their family parameters approach zero. This disproves the abstract lemma, not specialized nonample algebraic closure. None of the arguments above uses that closure chain.

notes.detailedSummary: For fixed actual L=A+D, every genuine τ with σ_D−C≤τ≤σ_D+C is uniquely σ_D+χ for bounded actual A-psh χ. Actual floor products agree, E_τ(u)=E_D(u)−E_D(τ), and D_τ(μ)=D_D(μ)−E_D(τ)+∫χdμ at mass A^n. Targets, attainment, continuous derivatives and uniqueness therefore agree. notes.text:
Retain n1’s hypotheses and fixed actual L=A+D. Let τ be genuine L-psh with σ−C≤τ≤σ+C everywhere. The quotient theorem gives τ=F_D(χ) for unique actual A-psh χ. Divisorial inequalities give |χ|≤C, and ample obstacle comparison extends both bounds everywhere. Conversely every bounded A-psh χ gives such a τ. Dominating by τ+O(1) and by σ+O(1) are equivalent, so their entire genuine cones coincide. For u=F_D(ψ), the retained relative difference is ψ−χ, including the unique quotient values on D, rather than subtraction of two original infinities.

The τ floors are F_D(max(ψ,χ−j)). Their independently constructed bounded actual products agree with the ample endpoint product on U∩{ψ>χ−j} by strict-winning locality. For finite-energy ψ these sets exhaust a full-measure locus, so the τ operator equals MA_A(ψ)=MA_D(u). For arbitrary associated nonpluripolar endpoints, compare two bounded references χ,χ' through z_ell=max(ψ,χ−ell,χ'−ell), with ell>max(j,k)+||χ−χ'||∞. The products agree with the product of z_ell on their overlapping strict winning sets. Increasing exhaustion of the finite locus gives identical positive limits, extended by zero across D. A finite tuple gives mixed compatibility. Bounded discontinuous χ is allowed because ample FS approximations and bounded maxima belong to the same generated local category.

For bounded ψ, the actual relative mixed integral with weight ψ−χ and factors T_u,T_τ is the ample cocycle E_A(ψ)−E_A(χ). The mixed and integrable weighted floor limits of n1 give E_τ(u)=E_D(u)−E_D(τ) for finite-energy endpoints. Consequently E1_τ=E1_D, E_τ(τ)=0, and the translation slope remains A^n. At target mass A^n, substitution gives D_τ(μ)=D_D(μ)−E_D(τ)+∫χdμ. The last term is finite because χ is bounded. Finite dual energy and every-E1 relative integrability are equivalent; the actual maximizers and genuine equations are identical. Outer energies differ by a constant, so all original continuous derivatives, comparison and uniqueness agree.

This does not identify all references of a big class. Choose a nonzero section of high qA with divisor E. Its divisor cannot be empty since A^n>0. For rational 0<t≤1, actual A_t=tA and D_t=D+(1−t)E/q satisfy L=A_t+D_t, using the actual section isomorphism O(E)=qA. Their masses are t^nA^n. At a divisorial valuation positive on E, scaling makes σ_Dt−σ_D unbounded below for t<1. These references are not boundedly equivalent. The construction also applies when L is nonample. Different masses are consistent with one nonpluripolar operator on different singularity types; they prevent silently assigning all these spaces one volume-mass target class. No general class operator is disproved.

notes.text:
Let L be any ACTUAL rational bundle with c1(L)=0 on the retained original X, dimension n≥1. Retain its canonical metric as reference zero and the literal BJ numerical single-net psh definition. No effective divisor representation is required. The endpoint metrics are e^(−C)||·||_triv,L on L itself.

For a genuine defining net φ_i in B_i with classes→0, put C_i=φ_i(v_0)↓C. Refine by rational ε→0 with εA−B_i actual ample. Choosing smaller ε first and sufficiently late i gives a directed final refinement even for a stationary net. Multiplication by generators makes (φ_i−C_i)/ε actual normalized A-FS. Compactness and finite continuous divisorial evaluation give εM_v≤φ_i(v)−C_i≤0 for each divisorial v. Passing to the limit and using n1’s ample embedding and all-point determination proves φ=C everywhere. Conversely actual L+εA is ample; its generating zero-weight FS functions are identically zero, with classes εc1(A)→0. They give one decreasing defining net for constants. Thus the ENTIRE genuine numerical cone is R. This is distinguished explicitly from a fixed-L section cone, which may be empty.

The operator is an actual metric product, not zero assigned by definition. Choose actual ample H. Both H+L and H are actual ample of the same numerical class. Canonical metric functoriality gives ||·||_triv,L=||·||_triv,H+L / ||·||_triv,H. The supplied BE v3 theorem makes this a continuous dpsh metric with independent signed multiadditive genuine products. G0’s trivial-model formula, applied only to the ample factors, gives its top product as Σ_j(−1)^(n−j)binom(n,j)((H+L)^jH^(n−j))δ_v0=L^nδ_v0=0. All numerical classes in the binomial terms are the same H, so cancellation is exact. Mixed numerical-zero actual bundles similarly give zero; decomposition and frame independence follow from the actual continuous metric construction.

An independent generated positive local construction uses a standard very ample frame with nonnegative raw canonical h_A and a frame of L with continuous raw h_L. Actual ample L+εA has finite generated weight w_ε=h_L+εh_A. These decrease locally to h_L and converge uniformly on compact frame neighborhoods. Their genuine global top products have mass ε^nA^n; mixed versions have mass ε^n(A_1⋯A_n). Compact local tests therefore tend to zero. The common actual ample collar from n1 compares these weights to independently supplied bounded generated decreasing nets with the same endpoint, whose explicit collar limits coincide. Thus all such local products agree with zero. No arbitrary local-current density theorem is assumed.

Adding constants changes no products. Reference floors are constant floors, and every mixed, decreasing-net and integrable relative-weight limit is zero. Actual mixed-integral energy is E_L(C)=0; the entire cone is finite energy. The normalized cone is a singleton. Continuous obstacle envelopes are constant infima. Every original continuous outer variation has constant minorants and zero energy, so both derivatives equal the integral against the constructed zero operator. The only positive target of raw mass zero is μ=0; its dual energy and every-constant integrability are finite. Every actual constant metric attains the objective and solves the equation, and all solutions differ by one real constant. Comparison is 0≤0; positive-mass domination is not asserted. No probability normalization occurs.

The actual bundle volume is genuinely zero. A nonzero section of cleared mL has effective divisor F. If F≠0, then F·H^(n−1)>0 for ample H, by positive ample intersections of prime components, or positive degree in dimension one. This contradicts numerical triviality. Hence F=0 and the section trivializes mL. Global regular functions on integral projective X are constants, so h0(mL) is zero or one, and limsup n!h0(mL)/m^n=0. An effective rational representative of a numerical-zero rational bundle must therefore be the zero divisor. Nonzero numerical-zero rational twists have no effective rational divisor representation.

notes.text:
The canonical full-original result is PARTIAL, candidate=false. Review114’s INCONCLUSIVE verdict and the earlier author’s candidate=false remain preserved. The prescribed residual-ample divisor theorem is n1, bounded-reference compatibility is n2, and the numerical-zero actual-bundle equation is n3. They do not solve unchanged original P16.5.

A concrete further mechanism constructs actual original functions. Normalize a nonempty genuine rational numerical cone to generic value zero and embed it in one actual ample H. Its finite maxima form an increasing net of normalized H-psh functions; n1 also proves these maxima remain in the given numerical class. At every divisorial valuation the supremum is finite, bounded below by one member and above by zero. Ample compactness gives an actual H-psh limit with exactly those divisorial supremum values. Each finite maximum is at most the limit everywhere by ample obstacle comparison. Conversely the usc supremum is an obstacle dominating the limit divisorially, so the reverse inequality follows. Thus V_θ=sup*{u genuine θ-psh,u(v_0)=0} exists as an actual all-point function independent of H. Scaling u(v)→u(tv)/t bijects the normalized defining cone, and the analytic scaling homeomorphism commutes with usc regularization, so V_θ is homogeneous. Big cones are nonempty by n1.

For every big ACTUAL L, choose a clearing m_0 with a nonzero section. Complete-system functions a_m=m^−1max_{basis H0(mL)}log||s||, m=m_0j!, are basis independent because all nonzero field coefficients have norm one. Section powers make them increase. Their generic values are zero and their divisorial supremum is finite. The same compactness/obstacle proof gives V_sec(L)=sup* a_m as an actual homogeneous H-psh function, independent of H and m_0. It dominates normalized fixed-L FS functions and is at most V_θ.

The decisive gap remains: these are increasing usc suprema. G0’s decreasing approximants have class H, not L. No single defining decreasing FS net with class limit c1(L) has been constructed for either candidate, so genuine nonample membership is unproved. Equality V_sec(L)=V_θ additionally requires comparison with varying actual B_i and numerical twists. The ambient ample operator has mass H^n, not minimal vol(L), and is not used as a substitute operator. The abstract flattening counterexample removes a shortcut without disproving specialized algebraic closure.

A complete original solution still requires: (1) minimal-singularity/general model-reference big cones with genuine membership, compactness, envelopes and orthogonality, independent bounded and unbounded original products with vol(L) mass in the minimal case, mixed and integrable weighted net limits, energy differentiation in every continuous direction, intrinsic targets, coercivity, actual attainment, comparison and uniqueness; (2) arbitrary nonbig pseudoeffective nonzero numerical data, including bundles without retained effective divisors, with an intrinsic datum and proved uniqueness formulation; (3) compatibility beyond boundedly equivalent prescribed-divisor types if a whole-cone/class-intrinsic equation is claimed. No lower-degree equation is constructed.

The known zero-volume obstruction is reconstructed: on P1×P1, L=p1*O(1) has h0(mL)=m+1 and L²=0. Finite normalized FS functions u_b=max(log||s0||,log||s1||+b)−b have ray values max(0,b−t)−b. Distinct b have generic value zero but different ray values, hence are not equal modulo constants. Supplied BE semiample products are positive with total mass zero, therefore all equal zero. A raw zero top-degree target cannot give uniqueness on this unrestricted cone. This counterexample alone is not a solution; the proved zero-volume ranges have constants-only retained cones.
